specials.name: Sushi
descriptions: Take a snack break — you've earned it.
A perfectly prepared sushi platter appears. Nobody asks where it came from.
The study gods have sent provisions.
Fresh. Delicious. Completely unrelated to kanji.
A small reward for a large amount of reading.
Your streak has attracted migrating sushi.
You found sushi. This is objectively a good outcome.

specials.name: Koinobori
descriptions: The carp swim upstream, just like your study grind.
The carp keep swimming. So do you.
Against the current, toward fluency.
Every expert was once a very determined fish.
The winds are favorable for studying.
The carp sees your Kanji statistics and approves.
One more card. Then another. That's how rivers are crossed.

specials.name: Black Belt
descriptions: The dojo is silent. The sensei nods. Barely.
The sensei says nothing. Somehow that's a compliment.
Your kanji form has improved.
A silent nod from the dojo.
The belt is black. The ink is black. Coincidence?
Years of training condensed into a random spinner result.
You are now qualified to misread advanced kanji with confidence.

specials.name: Fuji-san
descriptions: Sugoi! The sacred mountain blesses your session.
The mountain stands eternal. Your review queue does not.
Fuji-san watches over your studies.
A clear view of Fuji is considered lucky. So is this.
The sacred peak appears through the clouds.
Your session has been officially recognized by a mountain.
Even Fuji started from the bottom.

specials.name: Omamori
descriptions: A lucky charm joins your journey.
Fortune favors today's reviews.
An omamori watches over your studies.
Your streak is now under protection.
A little extra luck never hurts.
The shrine has acknowledged your effort.
You feel slightly luckier.
A blessing for the road ahead.

specials.name: Ramen Bowl
descriptions: Ichiraku Ramen. Naruto would be proud.
A steaming bowl of motivation.
Study first. Slurp later.
The aroma alone restores +10 focus.
Somewhere, a ramen chef believes in you.
Hot noodles. Hot streak.
Your concentration has been seasoned to perfection.

specials.name: Torii Gate
descriptions: The spirits are with you.
You pass briefly between worlds.
The spirits acknowledge your effort.
A sacred path opens before you.
For a moment, your reviews feel blessed.
Even the kami appreciate consistency.
The gate appears. Nobody knows why.

specials.name: Golden Kimono
descriptions: The most ornate garment in Japan, yours briefly.
Elegance has entered the chat.
For a brief moment, your studies become extremely fashionable.
An outfit worthy of a festival.
Tradition never goes out of style.
You are dressed for success. Temporarily.
The fabric alone costs more than your textbook.

specials.name: Kitsune
descriptions: A fox spirit has entered your session.
A fox spirit watches from the shadows.
You feel slightly smarter. This may be a trick.
The kitsune smiles. That's usually concerning.
Nine tails. Unknown intentions.
Something magical just happened. Probably.
The fox claims it knows all the jouyou kanji.

specials.name: Tanuki
descriptions: A tanuki has appeared. Verify everything.
The tanuki offers wisdom. Caution is advised.
A tanuki approves of your studies. Probably.
The tanuki knows all the answers. It will share none.
A suspiciously confident tanuki appears.
The tanuki claims you're doing great.
You have attracted a tanuki.
The tanuki is pleased. This changes nothing.

specials.name: Katana
descriptions: A katana takes 18 months to forge. You got one from a kanji spinner. Do not tell the swordsmith.
Forged by masters. Won from a study spinner.
Centuries of craftsmanship. Seconds of luck.
A blade worthy of legend.
The swordsmith would like a word.
The edge is flawless. Unlike your handwriting.
You unsheathe pure motivation.

specials.name: Ryū
descriptions: Japanese dragons swim through clouds. This one swam through your Wi-Fi. Nobody can explain it.
A dragon has noticed your studies.
The clouds part. Something enormous moves.
Legends say dragons reward perseverance.
The dragon circles once, then vanishes.
Ancient power. Terrible timing.
Nobody summoned the dragon. Yet here we are.

specials.name: Oni Mask
descriptions: An Oni has cursed your studies... Skip the card and prove the curse wrong!
The Oni challenges your dedication.
A curse has been placed upon your next review.
The demon laughs. Rude.
The Oni believes you'll quit now.
Prove the Oni wrong.
Your studies have attracted unwanted supernatural attention.

specials.name: Lost Kanji Scroll
descriptions: An ancient scroll has been uncovered.
The scroll contains no shortcuts.
Centuries of wisdom. Still need reviews.
The secret technique is more studying.
The scroll's contents remain classified.
An ancient master left this behind.
The scroll promises everything.
The final secret was practice.

specials.name: Gundam
descriptions: A Wild Gundam has interrupted your kanji studies. It does not explain itself. It never will.
A 20-meter robot has interrupted your studies.
Pilot not included.
The giant robot acknowledges your existence.
Some problems require flashcards. Others require a Gundam.
Nobody knows why it's here. Least of all the Gundam.
Your review session has escalated dramatically.

specials.name: Dango
descriptions: Dango, dango, dango, dango, dango daikazoku...
The dango council has convened.
An unusually important collection of rice balls appears.
The dango are pleased.
Nobody escapes the dango parade.
This event has no educational value.
You have been selected by the dango.

specials.name: Taiyaki
descriptions: You have been blessed by a fish-shaped pancake. Nobody knows why.
A fish-shaped pastry emerges from destiny.
Warm. Sweet. Slightly mysterious.
The taiyaki distribution system has chosen you.
Historians will be unable to explain this.
A golden taiyaki appears. Questions remain unanswered.
You have received the Fish of Knowledge. It contains red bean paste.

specials.name: Giga-Chad Samurai
descriptions: A legendary warrior blesses your session.
The old warrior has seen your studies. Continue.
A master of ten thousand battles blesses your session.
The samurai says nothing. Somehow, you feel encouraged.
The warrior approves of your dedication.
An ancient swordsman acknowledges your progress.

specials.name: Sakura Blizzard
descriptions: Cherry blossoms fill the air.
Spring arrives all at once.
The petals dance briefly.
For a moment, everything is pink.
The wind carries a thousand blossoms.
Even the review queue looks beautiful.
Peak bloom has arrived.
The season changes around you.
